sb_prompt: FIND OUT WHAT KIND OF PETS THE OTHER CALLER HAS.
raw_output:
ParticipantA: Hello!
ParticipantB: Hello!
ParticipantA: So, what kind of pets do you have?
ParticipantB: I have a dog and a cat.
ParticipantA: Nice. What kind of dog and cat do you have?
ParticipantB: I have a golden retriever and a Siamese cat.
ParticipantA: I used to have a golden retriever too. They're such great dogs.
ParticipantB: Yeah, they're amazing. What kind of cat did you have?
ParticipantA: I had a stray that I took in. She was a beautiful calico.
ParticipantB: That's so nice of you to take her in. What was her name?
ParticipantA: Her name was Whiskers.
ParticipantB: That's such a cute name. I named my cat Mr. Mistoffelees.
ParticipantA: That's a great name. So, how long have you had your dog and cat?
ParticipantB: I've had my dog for about 6 years now, and I got my cat about 2 years ago.
ParticipantA: Oh, that's a long time. I had my dog for about 12 years, but she passed away a few years ago.
ParticipantB: I'm sorry to hear that. Losing a pet is so hard.
ParticipantA: It is. But, I do have a new cat now. I got her about a year ago.
ParticipantB: That's great. What kind of cat is she?
ParticipantA: She's a tortoiseshell. She's very playful and affectionate.
ParticipantB: That sounds like my cat. He's very playful and loves to cuddle.
ParticipantA: Yeah, cats are great companions. So, do you have any other pets?
ParticipantB: No, just the dog and the cat. But, I used to have a hamster when I was a kid.
ParticipantA: Oh, I had a hamster too when I was a kid. I loved it so much.
ParticipantB: They're so cute. What did you name your hamster?
ParticipantA: I named her Cinnamon.
ParticipantB: That's such a cute name. I had a hamster named Houdini.
ParticipantA: That's a great name. So, do you have any other pets now or just the dog and the cat?
ParticipantB: Just the dog and the cat. But, I do love animals and I always want to get more.
ParticipantA: Yeah, I know what you mean. I always say I'm not going to get any more pets, but then I end up getting another one.
ParticipantB: Yeah, it's hard to resist. Well, it was nice talking to you.
ParticipantA: Nice talking to you too. Bye.
ParticipantB: Bye.
